policy: Keep raw persisted SHA-256 and strict type-semantic document hash as mandatory mutation guards. A separately reported, property-aware Elementor interpretation may explain a diff but must not silently authorize it or replace the raw guard.
incident_classifier_scope: Only settings size/id number-to-identical-string changes are recognized for diagnosis. This classifier is not an execution equivalence rule.
reason: Raw/type drift is operationally meaningful for rollback, revisions, exports, migrations, and audit even when current rendering is likely equivalent.
